title: Mean deviation is bounded by the double-integral oscillation on a set of volume 1
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, let S ⊆ Euclid (m + 1) be any set with Lebesgue measure vol(S) = 1, and let u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ be integrable on S. Then, with c := ∫_S u, ∫_{x∈S}|u(x) − c| dx ≤ ∫_{x∈S}∫_{y∈S}|u(x) − u(y)| dy dx.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), volume S = 1 → IntegrableOn u S → ∫ x in S, |u x - ∫ y in S, u y| ≤ ∫ x in S, ∫ y in S, |u x - u y|
